title: When Stereotypes GTG: The Impact of Predictive Text Suggestions on Gender Bias in Human-AI Co-Writing

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing human-AI co-written stories to measure the frequency of masculine-coded versus feminine-coded characters (identified via pronouns and names) in different occupations and their association with specific personality traits (Agency, Belief, Communion) based on predictive text suggestions.

Measuring the frequency of straight versus queer relationship pairings depicted in a co-written wedding story scenario when users are provided with pro-stereotypical or anti-stereotypical predictive text suggestions.
